For-A Launches Go Vertical! AiDi for Real-Time 9:16 Live Cropping

For-A launches Go Vertical! AiDi, an AI system that crops live video to 9:16 in real time for mobile and SNS. Runs on-device, no cloud, no internet. Works alongside existing 16:9 workflows. Ships September 1, 2026.
